selection: MERLIN_TARGET_PATH selects support explicitly and always wins. Unset, each target's vendored provider under examples/<example>/support is selected, keyed by its provider.yaml target, never by directory name; an empty value selects none. local_worktree paths are historical operator records of where each companion was developed, never runtime defaults.
qualification_scope: Read-only provider identity, exact source SHA256 parity, plugin reference existence, schema diagnostic parity. No hardware execution or compiler qualification.
candidate_boundary: Support plugins are experimenter-side answer-bearing code, not candidate payload. Every vendored examples/*/support tree is an answer surface whatever MERLIN_TARGET_PATH selects: agent sandboxes, bundle snapshots and clean rooms withhold it (only an explicit contracts/ grant can reach inside, and no bundle declares one), and publication refuses a support provider as a candidate. Existing recursive integrity policy remains unchanged.

vendoring.normalization: A vendored file may differ from its companion only where SOURCE.yaml lists it under normalized, with the companion blob id and the change. Absolute vendoring-host paths in provenance records are rewritten repo-relative there.
